facts.text: Element 52 is at 398 South Davis Street along the San Miguel River in Telluride, Colorado.
facts.excerpt: Element 52 is located at 398 South Davis Street along the San Miguel River in Telluride, Colorado.

facts.text: The property is within walking distance of historic downtown Telluride and has direct access to the slopes of Telluride Ski Resort.
facts.excerpt: The property is within walking distance of historic downtown Telluride and offers direct access to the slopes of Telluride Ski Resort.

facts.text: Residences have two to five bedrooms, spacious living areas and full kitchens.
facts.excerpt: Residences offer two to five bedrooms, spacious living areas and full kitchens

facts.text: A private funicular connects guests to the slopes, alongside an on-site ski valet, rentals and ski storage.
facts.excerpt: along with an on-site ski valet, rentals, ski storage and a private funicular connecting guests to the slopes.

facts.text: The property has two heated outdoor soaking pools, a private spa and a fitness center.
facts.excerpt: two heated outdoor soaking pools, a private spa, fitness center, ski lounge, heated underground parking, daily housekeeping and a year-round concierge.

facts.text: There is no restaurant on the property.
facts.excerpt: We currently do not have a restaurant on the property.

facts.text: Complimentary coffee, teas, hot cocoa, sodas, evening s'mores kits and wine or beer are available in the lobby.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary coffee, teas, hot cocoa and sodas, as as well as evening s’mores kits and wine/beers, are available in the lobby for our guests and owners.

facts.text: The residences have heating in winter but no air conditioning.
facts.excerpt: Our residences do not have A/C but do have heating in winter.

facts.text: Element 52 is approximately 15 minutes from Telluride Regional Airport.
facts.excerpt: Element 52 is approximately 15 minutes from Telluride Regional Airport (TEX)

facts.text: The resort fee is $40 per bedroom per night plus tax.
facts.excerpt: The resort fee is $40 per bedroom per night plus tax.

facts.text: Parking is valet only, in an indoor garage, with no self-parking.
facts.excerpt: Element 52 offers valet parking for $40 nightly per vehicle. We do not offer self-parking.

facts.text: A limited number of residences are pet-friendly.
facts.excerpt: We offer a limited number of pet-friendly residences.

facts.text: Pre-arrival grocery service, private chefs and local transportation can be arranged.
facts.excerpt: Pre-arrival grocery service, private chefs and local transportation can also be arranged.

facts.text: The resort fee includes house car service throughout the town of Telluride.
facts.excerpt: House car service throughout the town of Telluride

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler lists Element 52 under its Readers' Choice Awards 2021.
